verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad public REST API covering transactions, budgets, expenses with receipt upload, payments/vendors, onboarding and webhook registration. It uses scoped user tokens created from the dashboard and is backed by a changelog, Postman collections and an llms.txt index, which together let an AI-native user drive core product functions programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a discoverable standard path (the probe found 404s at all candidate locations).
